messages.content: How have you been feeling in general lately? Has your mood been pretty steady, or has it been kind of all over the place?
It has been all over the place. Some days I wake up feeling really down, and others I’m fine. It’s hard to predict.
That makes sense. When you think about what's coming up — whether it's next week, next month, or further ahead — how do you generally feel about it?
Honestly, I don't think that far ahead anymore. I just focus on getting through the day because the future feels too big to think about.
That sounds really tough. What kinds of things do you find yourself enjoying these days? Hobbies, time with people, specific activities — what brings you a sense of satisfaction?
Not much, to be honest. I used to love painting, but I haven’t picked up a brush in months. I just feel like I lost my purpose.
Thank you for sharing that. How's your energy level been? Are you able to tackle tasks and activities, or do you find yourself dragging?
I’m really tired most of the time. I wake up feeling exhausted, even after sleeping eight hours.
Thanks for being so open. Do you find it easy to focus on things — work, reading, conversations? Or has it been harder to concentrate lately?
It’s really hard. I try to focus on work, but my mind keeps wandering. I feel like I’m just going through the motions, waiting for the day to be over.
That makes sense. How has your sleep been? Are you sleeping okay, having trouble falling asleep, or waking up too early?
I wake up a lot. I don't really sleep anymore. I just lie there and stare at the ceiling.
I appreciate you telling me that. Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or eating habits lately? More, less, or about the same?
I haven't been eating much. Just the basics. Cooking or trying new things feels like too much effort.
I hear you. Do you find yourself feeling guilty a lot? About things you've done, or sometimes just in general?
Yes, all the time. I regret the divorce and the choices I made. I just feel like I lost my chance at a happy life.
That makes sense. How do you feel about yourself overall? Are you generally okay with who you are, or do you find yourself being quite critical?
I’m really hard on myself. I look at other people who have their lives together, and I just think I failed.

It sounds like you're carrying a lot of weight with those regrets and self-criticism. When you're feeling that way, do you find yourself getting easily frustrated or agitated, or perhaps having trouble making even small decisions? It's okay if that resonates, or if it doesn't – just wondering how those feelings show up for you.
I get really short with people. I don't mean to, but I just can’t deal with their questions or their advice right now. I feel like I’m a burden to everyone, so I just stay quiet.

That sounds incredibly draining, feeling like you're constantly walking on eggshells and carrying that weight. It takes a lot of energy to manage those feelings, and it's understandable you'd feel short with people. I'm wondering, when you have things to decide – even small things – do you find it harder now to come to a conclusion than it used to?
Yeah. It takes me forever. I used to be able to decide things in a second, but now it feels like I’m stuck in slow motion.

Thank you so much for sharing all of this with me today. It takes a lot of courage to be so open, and I really appreciate your willingness to talk. I hope you're able to find some moments of peace and kindness for yourself.
